dedupe_keys.name: avtobusna postajalisca v mestni obcini kranj

description: Avtobusna postajališča v Mestni občini Kranj is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MESTNA OBČINA KRANJ. The list includes all bus stops in the Municipality of Kranj. For most, the title is repeated twice, as these are two-way stops. Coverage: MESTNA OBČINA KRANJ. The portal shows the English title as "Bus stops in the Municipality of Kranj" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MESTNA OBČINA KRANJ. Its keywords include mestni promet, primestni potniški promet, avtobusna postajališča, avtobusna postaja. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
